newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CORE INFLATION RISES TO 7.9PCT Y/Y IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CORE INFLATION RISES TO 7.9PCT Y/Y IN FEB.

text.p: Greece's core consumer price inflation which does not include volatile food and energy prices increased to 7.9 percent year-on-year in February from 7.5 percent in January, an economist at a foreign bank told Reuters.
Headline CPI-based inflation eased to 6.6 percent year-on-year in February from 6.8 percent in January meaning that the gap between core and headline inflation rates widened.

The National Statistics Service (NSS) does not release core inflation but the central bank and the national economy ministry are known to monitor it. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
